items.title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
items.summary: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.

items.title: How Tristan Thompson invested in Anthropic over two years ago
items.summary: Former NBA Player Tristan Thompson explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how his NBA schedule afforded him the opportunity to be an early investor in Anthropic over two years ago, and why he's holding on to his investment.

items.title: Everything you need to know about the Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Anthropic is going public on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT in what could be the biggest IPO ever. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen walks through the numbers and the record demand, how seven OpenAI researchers built a $1.5 trillion company in six years, the $1 trillion compute bill ahead and the bull and bear case for buying in.
